newsitem.title: UK: UK adviser Congdon wants rate rise.
newsitem.headline: UK adviser Congdon wants rate rise.

text.p: Professor Tim Congdon, an adviser to British Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke, said on Wednesday he favoured an interest rate rise from six percent but had toned down his previous call for a one point increase.
He said he wanted a rate rise of at least half a percent because he was worried by a "rather high" rate of economic growth and rising house prices.
Congdon told BBC radio he was very puzzled and surprised by the recent sharp increase in sterling, and did not fully understand it.
